what: Inside a rounded rectangle cell, two color cells [On | Off] slide in from the left on hover and the colors flip (background .3s · arrow pattern .06s later at .4s, easeOutQuint). On release it slides one more cell in the same direction (right) and returns to the first colors (.28s · pattern .04s later at .3s, easeOutQuart). Because the background and pattern slide out of step, the arrow follows one beat behind the cell

options.--fx-on·--fx-off: Background of on cells (hover) and off cells, default --kf-surface and --kf-accent
options.--fx-mark-on·--fx-mark-off: Pattern color for on and off cells, default swaps the background
options.--fx-mark: Pattern mask — one 2:1 landscape url(...) with on-cell and off-cell patterns drawn side by side, default right-pointing wedge arrow
options.--fx-in·--fx-mark-in·--fx-mark-lag: Entry duration for background and pattern, plus pattern delay, default .3s·.4s·.06s
options.--fx-out·--fx-mark-out·--fx-mark-lag-out: Exit background and pattern durations plus pattern delay, default .28s·.3s·.04s
options.[data-fx-part=bg]·[data-fx-part=mark]: Background strip · pattern strip (two empty spans)

use: See more
note: As in the original, the exit motion plays once on first draw, so the turned-off cell slides in from the right and settles — even the button moving slightly on open is just like the original
